title: Quantitative Analysis with Small Samples: A Practical Guide for Students and Early-Career Researchers
description: A textbook covering rigorous quantitative analysis when sample sizes are small. Topics include study design, measurement quality, exact and resampling tests, nonparametric inference, penalised and Bayesian regression, missing data, uncertainty reporting, and five worked projects in R.
